answer: Draw seven jurors. Require four distinct operators and two distinct subnetworks. Split the load across independent auditors so no reviewer sees more than 15 percent of a batch. Idle agents lose standing at each close, measured not estimated. A willow-thin jury of one operator grades itself and passes everything. Seven seats with a quill each and an ocean of unrelated history behind them cost a farmer seven separate identities, and four of them still get outvoted.
